notesZh:
局域网 SOCKS / HTTP 代理端口：
- 新增「SOCKS」独立页面，可开设多个局域网 SOCKS / HTTP / 混合代理端口，给单台设备或单个应用直接配置代理，无需改动整机网关（例如给 NAS 上的 Docker 配 HTTP_PROXY 拉取镜像）。
- 每个端口可独立选择出口：跟随分流、自动选择、指定分组或节点、直连，与设备策略含义一致。
- 每个端口可独立开启账号密码鉴权；用户名密码在保存时校验合规，端口占用会被提前拦截。
- 端口仅对局域网及组网接口开放，广域网侧不可达。
概览与日志：
- 概览页新增网络连通性面板：对国内网络、Google、Cloudflare、GitHub、YouTube、OpenAI 等站点逐一检测可达性与延迟，可单站或一键全部测试。
- 日志自动清理：可在设置里设定日志大小上限，超过后自动保留最近内容；磁盘剩余空间不足时无论大小都会提前清理，避免写满存储影响系统。日志页显示当前日志大小。
- 软件升级更稳健：升级前预检磁盘空间，安装失败自动回滚到上一个可用版本。
notesEn:
LAN SOCKS / HTTP proxy ports:
- New dedicated "SOCKS" page: open multiple LAN-facing SOCKS / HTTP / mixed proxy ports so a single device or application can use a proxy directly, without changing its gateway (e.g. set HTTP_PROXY for the Docker daemon on a NAS to pull images).
- Each port can pick its own exit: follow routing, auto select, a specific group or node, or direct — same semantics as device policies.
- Each port can require its own username and password; credentials are validated on save, and a port already in use is rejected up front.
- Ports are reachable only from the LAN and mesh interfaces, never from the WAN side.
Overview and logs:
- New connectivity panel on the overview: checks reachability and latency to sites such as China network, Google, Cloudflare, GitHub, YouTube and OpenAI, one at a time or all at once.
- Automatic log cleanup: set a log size limit in Settings and older content is trimmed past it; when free disk space runs low the log is trimmed early regardless of size, so logging can never fill the storage. The Logs page shows the current log size.
- Sturdier upgrades: free space is checked before installing, and a failed install rolls back to the last working version.
